source.purpose: The starting block library: the 15 blocks from the Student Advocate reference implementation, with their design docs and journey cards.

blocks.name: egress
blocks.purpose: The one door to the network: allow-listed https hosts, named purposes, recorded

blocks.name: evidence
blocks.purpose: Append-only, pseudonymous record of what the factory and the product did

blocks.name: explore
blocks.purpose: Walks every action from every state to a fixpoint, checking invariants

blocks.name: gates
blocks.purpose: Gates that count only after planted defects make them fail; verdicts and ratchets

blocks.name: intent
blocks.purpose: Locked journey cards: goals in plain words, run in every mode and channel

blocks.name: models
blocks.purpose: Model calls behind one interface, with a twin, budgets and family labels

blocks.name: operator
blocks.purpose: Leases, idempotent dispatches confirmed by lookup, and holds

blocks.name: plain-language
blocks.purpose: Reading grade, phrase rules and carelessness checks for any text

blocks.name: privacy
blocks.purpose: Canary tracing of sensitive fields and small-cell suppression

blocks.name: review
blocks.purpose: A multi-family review panel that can fail a change, never pass one alone

blocks.name: runtime
blocks.purpose: Consent ledger, sealed facts, approvals, outbound gate and refuse-to-start

blocks.name: store
blocks.purpose: Owner-scoped document store and the classified data declaration

blocks.name: twin-service
blocks.purpose: Clock, scenarios, health and OpenAPI for synthetic services

blocks.name: twins
blocks.purpose: Twins of outside services (SMS, mail, calendars) with calibration dates

blocks.name: ui
blocks.purpose: Accessible, themed page parts shared by the app and the factory console
